subject.title: [Bug]: TLS certificate pin mismatch loop when connecting through Cloudflare Tunnel/Access (anycast edge certs)

question: What endpoint-identity contract should iOS use for manually configured public WSS domains whose valid certificates rotate across CDN or anycast edges?
rationale: Choosing between system CA trust and application-level pinning changes the security boundary and persisted trust model; source inspection can establish the bug but cannot authorize that policy choice.

options.title: Use mode-specific trust
options.body: Use system chain and hostname validation for manually entered public WSS domains while retaining explicit pinning for discovered or self-signed gateways, with a focused stored-pin migration.

options.title: Adopt rotation-stable pins
options.body: Keep mandatory application pinning but replace the single leaf fingerprint with a bounded SPKI, issuer, or multi-pin identity contract and explicit expiry semantics.

options.title: Keep leaf TOFU
options.body: Continue pinning one leaf certificate and document CDN or anycast TLS termination as unsupported, leaving the reported remote path unusable.

recommendation.title: Use mode-specific trust
recommendation.body: Use system chain and hostname validation for manually entered public WSS domains while retaining explicit pinning for discovered or self-signed gateways, with a focused stored-pin migration.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this person with both iOS and security ownership, and their history covers the affected manual TLS and connection paths.
